metadata.description: Audio notifications for Claude Code, Cursor IDE & Codex CLI, configured in natural language. 39 hook events + 44 matcher variants, each with its own sound. Desktop toasts, TTS, webhook fan-out, status line + per-subagent rows, rate-limit alerts. Auto-bridges to Cursor 3.2.16+; native install for Cursor-only via 'audio-hooks install --cursor'; native install for Codex via 'audio-hooks install --codex'.
